# LeadSnipper — Complete Content Reference

> LeadSnipper is a cold email and outbound infrastructure platform for SaaS teams and agencies, built on AWS SES, with tools for deliverability, email warmup, campaign automation, and lead sourcing.

Last updated: 2026-07-28

---

## Product Overview

LeadSnipper is a deliverability-first cold email platform that helps businesses send from infrastructure they control — Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, SMTP, or AWS SES — with intelligent reputation protection, AI-powered personalization, and advanced campaign automation.

### Core Capabilities

- Bring Your Own AWS SES sending infrastructure or use managed sending
- Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 OAuth connection (one-click)
- Custom SMTP/IMAP support (Zoho, Fastmail, GoDaddy, corporate mail servers)
- Built-in Reoon email verification (BYO Reoon account)
- AI-powered email warmup with realistic conversation threads
- Domain health dashboard (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce rates, complaints)
- Campaign builder with personalization, variables, spintax, attachments
- Sender rotation across multiple mailboxes
- Daily pacing and mailbox-aware sending limits
- Multi-step follow-up sequences (auto-stops on reply)
- Bounce auto-pause — campaign halts instantly on hard bounce
- Campaign analytics: deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes
- AI cold email writer using your knowledge base and tone
- Lead, list, tag, and CSV upload workflows

### Who It's For

- B2B founders and operators running founder-led outbound
- Sales and SDR teams that need safer cold email operations
- Growth teams that care about deliverability, list quality, and cost control
- Agencies managing outbound for multiple clients or sending domains

## Cold Email Software

LeadSnipper is cold email software built on AWS SES. It automates outreach, verifies leads, warms up domains, and tracks deliverability — all in one platform.

Key features:
- Campaign builder with multi-step follow-up sequences
- Spintax for unique email variants ({Hey|Hello|Hi} syntax)
- Personalization with {{first_name}}, {{company}}, custom variables
- Sender rotation across all connected inboxes
- Granular daily caps per mailbox and per domain
- Attachment support
- A/B testing for subject lines
- AI-generated drafts from your knowledge base

---

## Cold Email Infrastructure

Own your cold email infrastructure with BYO AWS SES. No shared pools, no reputation risk from other senders. LeadSnipper gives you full sending control plus verification and warmup.

BYO SES means "Bring Your Own" Amazon Simple Email Service. You own your sending reputation, IP pools, and domain setup. If you don't know AWS, use Managed mode — everything is handled for you.

### BYO SES vs Shared Infrastructure

When your cold email tool owns your sending infrastructure, their problems become your problems. With BYO SES:
- You own your sending reputation
- No cross-contamination from other senders
- Full control over IP pools and domain setup
- AWS charges $0.10 per 1,000 emails (no markup)

---

## Email Warmup

LeadSnipper's AI warmup engine generates realistic email conversations across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Zoho, and SES. It creates natural threads with 5-8 exchanges, varied writing styles, and proper timing.

How it works:
1. Gradually ramps sending volume from day 1
2. Mirrors human sending patterns
3. Pauses automatically when domain health drops
4. Creates real engagement signals (opens, replies, thread depth)
5. Runs 24/7 in background even during active campaigns

Minimum warmup period: 2-3 weeks for new domains. Conservative teams warm for 4-6 weeks.

## Guide: Amazon SES Pricing 2026

Amazon SES costs $0.10 per 1,000 outbound emails when sending from outside EC2. Full breakdown:
- Outbound: $0.10 per 1,000 emails
- Data transfer: $0.12 per GB outbound
- Dedicated IPs: $24.95/month per IP
- Free tier: 62,000 emails/month from EC2 instances

For 100,000 cold emails/month: ~$10 to AWS + LeadSnipper platform fee.

## Guide: How to Set Up AWS SES for Cold Email

Step-by-step process:
1. Create AWS account
2. Navigate to SES console
3. Verify sending domain (DNS records)
4. Set up DKIM (3 CNAME records)
5. Configure SPF (TXT record)
6. Set up DMARC policy
7. Request sandbox exit (production access)
8. Configure sending limits
9. Connect to LeadSnipper
10. Begin warmup

## Guide: How to Scale Cold Email Without Getting Blacklisted

Key principles:
- Warm up every new domain for 2-4 weeks
- Verify every lead before sending (target <2% bounce rate)
- Start at 30-50 emails/day per domain, scale gradually
- Use separate domains per ICP or product line
- Monitor bounce rates, complaint rates, and open rates daily
- Auto-pause campaigns on hard bounces
- Use sender rotation across multiple mailboxes
- Keep warmup running even during active campaigns

## Guide: Domain Reputation Management

Your domain reputation decides inbox vs spam. Key metrics:
- Bounce rate: Keep below 2%
- Complaint rate: Keep below 0.1%
- Sender score: Monitor via Google Postmaster Tools
- DNS authentication: DKIM, SPF, DMARC must all pass

Recovery strategies for blacklisted domains:
1. Stop all sending immediately
2. Identify and fix the root cause
3. Request delisting from blacklist providers
4. Begin fresh warmup with small, verified lists
5. Monitor health daily for 4-6 weeks

## Guide: SPF, DKIM, DMARC Explained

SPF (Sender Policy Framework): DNS TXT record that lists authorized sending servers for your domain.
DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail): Cryptographic signature proving the email wasn't modified in transit.
DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting & Conformance): Policy telling receiving servers what to do when SPF or DKIM fail.

All three are required for cold email deliverability. Missing any one increases spam folder risk significantly.

## Guide: How Many Emails Per Day Per Domain

Guidelines by domain age:
- New domain (0-2 weeks warmup): 5-15 emails/day
- Warming domain (2-4 weeks): 15-50 emails/day
- Established domain (4+ weeks): 50-200 emails/day
- Multi-domain setup: 500-2,000+ emails/day across domains

AWS SES default limit: 200 emails/day (sandbox), then request increase.

## Guide: Email Warmup, Verification & Domain Health

The three pillars of cold email deliverability:

1. Email Warmup: Gradually builds sender reputation through realistic conversations
2. Email Verification: Removes invalid, catch-all, and risky addresses before sending
3. Domain Health Monitoring: Tracks DNS, bounces, complaints, and reputation signals

Skip any one and your campaigns land in spam.

## Guide: Email List Cleaning

Always verify before sending. An agency uploaded 10,000 unverified leads — bounce rate hit 15% in the first hour. The domain was blacklisted within 24 hours.

Best practices:
- Verify every email before importing to campaigns
- Remove all "risky" and "invalid" results
- Re-verify lists older than 90 days
- Use built-in Reoon verification for convenience
- Target <2% bounce rate on every campaign

## Guide: BYO AWS SES vs Shared Infrastructure

BYO SES advantages:
- Full control over sending reputation
- No cross-contamination from other users
- AWS charges $0.10/1K emails directly
- Unlimited domains on your SES account
- Scale independently without platform limits

Shared infrastructure risks:
- Other users' bad behavior affects your deliverability
- Platform outages impact all customers simultaneously
- Less control over IP reputation and sending patterns

## Guide: Best Cold Email Software 2026

9 tools compared: LeadSnipper, Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Mailshake, Woodpecker, Apollo, Outreach, SalesLoft.

Key differentiator: infrastructure ownership. Tools using BYO SES give users full control over sender reputation. Shared infrastructure tools trade convenience for reputation risk.

## Guide: Why Cold Emails Land in Spam

5 real reasons:
1. Domain reputation damage (no warmup, bad lists)
2. Missing DNS authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
3. High bounce rates (unverified lists)
4. Sending too fast (no pacing or daily limits)
5. Content triggers (spam words, links, formatting)

Fix: Verify lists, warm up domains, authenticate DNS, pace sends, test content.

## Guide: Cold Email vs Newsletter Tools

Newsletter platforms (Mailchimp, Mailerlite, ConvertKit) are built for opt-in subscribers. Using them for cold email will:
- Get your account banned (TOS violation)
- Flag your domain as spam sender
- Lose your email list and data

Use purpose-built cold email platforms with BYO SES for outbound.

## Guide: Apollo.io Data Quality & Bounce Rate

Users consistently report 8-15% bounce rates from Apollo's "verified" emails. Apollo's verification means format is valid — not that the mailbox exists. Always re-verify Apollo exports through Reoon, NeverBounce, or ZeroBounce before sending.

## Guide: Cold Email Open Rate Dropping

A sudden open-rate drop is usually a deliverability warning:
1. Check domain reputation in Google Postmaster Tools
2. Verify DNS records are still valid
3. Review bounce rates from recent campaigns
4. Check warmup status
5. Audit list quality and verification status
6. Review sending volume and pacing

---

## Cold Email by Industry

### Cold Email for SaaS
Challenges: Long sales cycles, multiple ICPs, high-volume outreach risks. Solution: Separate domains per ICP, verify every lead, warm up 2-4 weeks, keep daily volume under 50 per domain until established.

### Cold Email for B2B Startups
Challenges: One domain mistake kills all company email, limited budget. Solution: Buy separate outreach domains, start with 10-20 emails/day, verify every lead, track reply rates by ICP.

### Cold Email for Agencies
Challenges: Multi-client domain management, shared reputation risk. Solution: Separate domains per client, BYO SES per client, PDF reports, verify all client lists before launch.

### Cold Email for Recruiters
Challenges: High-volume triggers spam filters, stale LinkedIn exports. Solution: Verify candidate emails, role-specific subjects, rotate 2-3 sending domains.

### Cold Email for Consultants
Challenges: Limited budget, personal brand depends on inbox placement. Solution: Send from personal domain, keep volume modest (20-40/day), genuine personalization.

### Cold Email for Healthcare
Challenges: HIPAA considerations, aggressive spam filtering. Solution: Never include PHI, verify against role-based emails, professional tone, warm 3-4 weeks.

### Cold Email for Fintech
Challenges: Compliance requirements, stricter spam filtering. Solution: Dedicated outreach domain, avoid financial claims, verify all contacts, monitor complaint rates.

### Cold Email for Real Estate
Challenges: Outdated property owner lists, compliance. Solution: Verify property owner emails, local domain names, low initial volume, clear opt-out.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can I use my existing Gmail or Microsoft 365 account?
Yes. Connect any Google Workspace inbox or Microsoft 365 / Outlook account via OAuth in one click. No passwords stored. Custom SMTP/IMAP is also supported.

### What email guardrails protect my sender reputation?
Four systems: (1) Multi-step follow-up sequences auto-stop on reply. (2) Spintax randomizes copy. (3) Bounce auto-pause halts campaigns on hard bounce. (4) Granular daily caps per mailbox and per domain with inbox rotation.

### What is the Premium Managed AWS SES service?
Done-for-you infrastructure: dedicated IPs, sending limit increases, bounce management, ongoing deliverability monitoring. You keep your brand and domains. Ideal for agencies sending 100K-500K+ emails/month.

### Why should I use LeadSnipper instead of Instantly?
You bring your own AWS SES — you own your reputation, deliverability, and data. Built-in Reoon verification, AI-powered warmup, and domain health dashboard that Instantly doesn't offer.

### What is BYO SES? Do I need to know AWS?
BYO SES means "Bring Your Own" Amazon Simple Email Service. If you don't know AWS, choose Managed mode — everything is handled for you.

### How does the AI email writer work?
Generates drafts using your knowledge base and tone. Edit and send, saving hours per campaign. Gets you 80% there fast.

### How does AI warmup actually do?
Generates realistic email conversations across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Zoho, and SES. Natural threads with 5-8 exchanges, varied writing styles, proper timing. Builds sender trust before cold campaigns.

### Is there a free trial?
Yes. Start free with no credit card. 1,000 emails, 500 contacts, basic analytics, API access for 1 month.

### Do you have CRM integrations?
HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Make, Clay, Zoho, and Google Sheets. Full REST API for custom workflows.
